messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: Symmetry-restricted ansatz decomposing the square into congruent subregions with one point each

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "A symmetry-restricted ansatz using the C_4v symmetry group with one point at the center (1/2,1/2), four points on the midlines at (1/2,a), (a,1/2), (1-a,1/2), (1/2,1-a), and four points on the diagonals at (b,b), (1-b,b), (b,1-b), (1-b,1-b), with four additional points at (c,d), (1-c,d), (c,1-d), (1-c,1-d) with a≈0.235, b≈0.205, c≈0.11, d≈0.11, achieves a minimum triangle area of approximately 0.011, where the binding constraint is a collinear-near-degenerate triangle among a midline point, a diagonal point, and a corner-cluster point."}
